description: This file defines a template class 'IteratorType' within the 'WPEFramework::RPC' namespace. The class provides an iterator implementation for various container types, supporting operations like reset, previous, next, and current element retrieval. It is designed to be used as a base for iterators over different data structures, with methods for reference counting and interface mapping.

classes.name: IteratorType
classes.description: A template iterator class that provides iteration capabilities over a container, supporting navigation and element access, with reference counting and interface mapping.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the container.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element pointed to by the iterator.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an element to the container.
